comment: Judgment calls for the MathML Core document. MathML Core has no per-element IDL (every element is a MathMLElement), so element attributes come from browser-compat-data (standard-track only) and their types from here, following the MathML Core attribute definitions.

class.reason: Set of space-separated class names (MathML Core global attribute; not listed by browser-compat-data).

id.reason: MathML Core global attribute; not listed by browser-compat-data.

style.reason: MathML Core global attribute; not listed by browser-compat-data.

data.reason: data-* attributes are MathML Core globals; not listed by browser-compat-data.

displaystyle.reason: MathML Core boolean-valued attribute (true/false keywords, not an HTML boolean attribute).

href.reason: Hyperlink target (MathMLAnchorElement in mathml-core.idl, which @webref/elements does not yet link to the a element).

mathvariant.reason: MathML Core only defines the value normal.
